No pricing context or comparable listing shown; photo does not support this.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired
claims.evidence: Photo 0 does not show seals, inspection marks, or internal condition.
Overheating cannot be confirmed from a box photo.

claims.claim: original pads and the UK receipt
claims.evidence: No controllers ('pads') or receipt are visible/readable in photo 0.

risks.risk: Console model/version is unclear (original vs Slim vs Pro), which changes value and compatibility.
risks.proof: Photo of the console label showing the CUH model number (and region) plus a photo of the front ports.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the lowest-value PS4 type you can confirm from photos (worst case: not the higher-value variant).

risks.risk: Accessories may be incomplete (missing HDMI/power/charging cables, missing controller, missing headset/USB, etc.).
risks.proof: Lay out all items on camera: controller(s), power cable, HDMI, USB cable, and show each clearly.
risks.if_unproven: Price as missing some accessories (worst case: not complete).

risks.risk: Games may be fewer than claimed or discs may be damaged/region-locked.
risks.proof: Photo/clip showing all 7 game discs (front and back) and a quick boot/test of one game.
risks.if_unproven: Price as fewer/unknown condition games (worst case: not usable).

risks.risk: Port faults (HDMI, USB, audio) or controller issues may exist.
risks.proof: Video showing the console powered on, controller connected, HDMI output working, and at least one USB device recognized.
risks.if_unproven: Price as ports/controllers may be faulty (worst case: not fully working).

risks.risk: Overheating/thermal issues may cause shutdowns or fan problems.
risks.proof: Short stress test clip: run a game for several minutes and show stable operation + fan sound/temperature behavior (or error-free session).
risks.if_unproven: Price as potential overheating risk (worst case: may overheat).

risks.risk: Receipt/region claims may be false; could be a repackaged box or mismatched items.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the UK receipt (with date/serial if present) and matching serial number on the console label.
risks.if_unproven: Price without trust in receipt/region (worst case: no proof of authenticity).

proof_requests: Photo of the console itself (front + back) and the label with CUH model number/serial.
Photos of every accessory laid out (controller(s), HDMI, power cable, USB, etc.) and show they are included.
Photos of all 7 games (each disc front/back) and a quick video booting one game.
Video test: power on, controller pairing, HDMI display working, and at least one USB port test.
Photo of the receipt (clear) and a matching serial number on the console label.
response.reason: From photo 0, only the PS4 box is visible; the console model, completeness of accessories, number/condition of games, and port/overheating status cannot be verified remotely. To price safely, you need proof photos/videos of the console label, included items, and functional tests.
